name: aac-dct-simd-armv7
reason: Cause, counts and output identity of the AAC decoder's vector DCT-IV passes and its scratch that is no longer zeroed, one c6g.4xlarge host (Graviton2) from the 32-bit ARMv7 gate image: perf stat user-mode instructions, cycles and branch misses of the gate build of codec-aac-worker (pinned nightly, aac-simd) at b78dab15, of each change and of the reference on the five AAC workloads, with digests; perf records with symbol reports of b78dab15, the final build and the reference on the HE-AAC workloads, the Parametric Stereo time by source line and the callers of memset by sampled link register at b78dab15; the 39 aac-lane vectors decoded to f32 by the AAC decode example with and without simd at b78dab15 and the change, byte-identical; the stable codec-worker's counts on the file and codec workloads and the playback workers' SHA-256 at e9596487 and the change; the codec-aac and codec-opus tests; binaries' and inputs' SHA-256, toolchain and host details; cited by docs/status.md for the ARMv7 timing of the HE-AAC workloads.
